thread:
Aisha K.: FYI I opened a short PR to add a migration recipe that covers reserved vs preemptible pools + autoscale policy caveats. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4189 :memo:
Tom B.: 👍 Can you add a minimal Python SDK example? Folks keep asking for both TF and Python.
Aisha K.: Done. Added Terraform, JS, and Python. Python uses the sync client pattern we used in other quickstarts. Snippet: ```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient()
client.capacity.create(
    tenant_id="acme",
    reserved_pool="gold-pool",
    autoscale={"target_rps": 200, "cooldown_s": 300},
    isolation_preference="reserved"
)
```
Nina R.: Can we also make explicit that "isolation_preference" is advisory and final placement still respects tenant priority and pool capacity? Put that note right after the snippet.
Aisha K.: Added that note and a short bullet: "advisory -> scheduler may override when capacity constrained".
Tom B.: SLA/legal ask: we need a single-sentence clear callout that preemptible pools are not covered by the standard latency SLA; include suggested language so legal can copy-paste.
Aisha K.: Added a suggested sentence: "Preemptible pool allocations are best-effort for latency-sensitive workloads and are excluded from the standard 99th‑percentile latency SLA; use reserved pools for SLA-backed deployments."
eng-runtime: Quick technical note: quantized model cold-start on older GPUs may add ~200-400ms to the first few tokens after placement. Also, eviction on preemptible instances triggers a graceful-drain hook but clients should implement retry/backoff.
Aisha K.: Added a parenthetical about quantized cold-start and a short example retry snippet for streaming clients. Streaming retry snippet: ```js
// pseudo: resume streaming after reconnect
stream.on('error', async (err) => {
  await sleep(300);
  client.stream.resume({requestId: lastRequestId});
});
```
Nina R.: Docs nit: in the migration checklist, reorder steps to start with a small reserved pool, mirror traffic, validate latency, then promote. Keep the list 4 bullets.
Aisha K.: Reordered bullets and added a 15m "quiet window" recommendation from eng-platform about promotion.
